texts: RTS 2024/1774 — article 16 : acquisition, développement et maintenance des systèmes TIC
Politique interne PDS-2 (Banque Kerlann, fictive) — développement sécurisé

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document and implement a policy governing the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems.
requirements.summary: Requires a documented policy governing ICT systems acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of the policy document itself, which is not visible through the code tree/file/search interface.

requirements.quote: identify security practices and methodologies relating to the acquisition, development, and maintenance of ICT systems;
requirements.summary: Requires the policy to identify security practices and methodologies for acquisition, development and maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of policy content, not testable through read-only code and CI files.

requirements.quote: specify measures to mitigate the risk of unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation of the ICT systems during development, maintenance, and deployment.
requirements.summary: Requires the policy to specify measures against unintentional alteration or intentional manipulation during development, maintenance and deployment.
requirements.why: Requires review of policy measures, not observable through code content alone.

requirements.quote: financial entities shall develop, document, and implement an ICT systems' acquisition, development, and maintenance procedure for the testing and approval of all ICT systems prior to their use and after maintenance.
requirements.summary: Requires a documented procedure for testing and approval of ICT systems before use and after maintenance.
requirements.why: Requires review of the testing and approval procedure document, not visible via repository code search.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain source code reviews covering both static and dynamic testing, including security testing for internet-exposed systems and applications.
requirements.summary: Requires source code reviews covering static and dynamic testing including security testing for internet-exposed systems.
requirements.why: Static testing part is testable through CI configuration via the read-only interface and is covered by the internal policy control.

requirements.quote: identify and analyse vulnerabilities and anomalies in the source code;
requirements.summary: Requires identification and analysis of vulnerabilities and anomalies in source code.
requirements.why: Requires review of vulnerability analysis reports, not derivable from code content alone.

requirements.quote: adopt an action plan to address those vulnerabilities and anomalies;
requirements.summary: Requires adoption of an action plan to address identified vulnerabilities and anomalies.
requirements.why: Requires review of the remediation action plan document, not visible via code search.

requirements.quote: monitor the implementation of that action plan.
requirements.summary: Requires monitoring of the implementation of the vulnerability action plan.
requirements.why: Requires review of follow-up and monitoring records, not testable through read-only code files.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall contain security testing of software packages no later than at the integration phase.
requirements.summary: Requires security testing of software packages no later than at integration.
requirements.why: Integration-phase package testing is testable through CI and dependency files and is covered by the internal policy control.

requirements.quote: non-production environments only store anonymised, pseudonymised, or randomised production data;
requirements.summary: Requires non-production environments to store only anonymised, pseudonymised or randomised production data.
requirements.why: Use of synthetic versus production data in versioned fixtures is testable via repository search and is covered by the internal policy control.

requirements.quote: financial entities are to protect the integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
requirements.summary: Requires protection of integrity and confidentiality of data in non-production environments.
requirements.why: Requires review of access and protection arrangements for non-production data, not provable by code search alone.

requirements.quote: the procedure shall include controls to protect the integrity of source code of ICT systems that are developed in-house or by an ICT third-party service provider.
requirements.summary: Requires controls to protect integrity of source code developed in-house or by third-party providers.
requirements.why: Requires review of code integrity controls like branch protection and signing, not visible through tree/file/search content.

requirements.quote: proprietary software and, where feasible, the source code provided by ICT third-party service providers, as well as source code coming from open-source projects, are to be analysed and tested in accordance with paragraph 3 prior to their deployment in the production environment.
requirements.summary: Requires proprietary, third-party and open-source code to be analysed and tested per paragraph 3 before production deployment.
requirements.why: Dependency analysis and testing before deployment is testable through requirements and CI files and is covered by the internal policy control.

requirements.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.
requirements.summary: Prohibits hardcoded secrets in source or versioned configuration; secrets must come from a vault or environment variables.
requirements.why: Testable by searching versioned code and configuration for literal secrets via the read-only search and file interface.

controls.title: No hardcoded secrets in versioned code and configuration
controls.objective: Verify that no passwords, keys or tokens appear in clear text and that secrets come from a vault or environment variables.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list files; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(password|passwd|secret|api[_-]?key|token)\s*=\s*['"][^'"]+['"] and q=BEGIN.*PRIVATE KEY; for each match GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> to verify whether value is a literal or loaded via os.environ, os.getenv or vault client.
controls.expected: Zero hardcoded secret values; all secrets referenced via os.environ/os.getenv or vault client.
controls.risk: Hardcoded secrets allow credential theft from repository access and widen breach impact.
controls.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets to a vault or environment variables and rotate exposed credentials.
controls.quote: Aucun secret (mot de passe, clé, jeton) n'est écrit en clair dans le code source ni dans la configuration versionnée : les secrets viennent d'un coffre ou de variables d'environnement.

requirements.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).
requirements.summary: Requires all outgoing network calls to verify the server TLS certificate and never disable verification.
requirements.why: Testable by searching code for TLS verification disabling patterns via the read-only search interface.

controls.title: TLS server certificate verification never disabled
controls.objective: Verify that outgoing network calls verify TLS certificates and that verification is never disabled.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=verify\s*=\s*False and q=ssl\._create_unverified_context and q=CERT_NONE; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> for each match to confirm context and absence of justification.
controls.expected: Zero matches for verify=False, unverified SSL context or CERT_NONE; requests/http clients use default verification.
controls.risk: Disabled TLS verification exposes SEPA transfers to man-in-the-middle interception and data alteration.
controls.recommendation: Remove verify=False and unverified contexts and enforce default TLS certificate verification.
controls.quote: Tout appel réseau sortant vérifie le certificat TLS du serveur : la vérification n'est jamais désactivée (`verify=False` interdit).

requirements.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.
requirements.summary: Requires passwords hashed with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and prohibits MD5 and SHA-1 for security uses.
requirements.why: Testable by searching code for hashing libraries and forbidden hash functions via the read-only search interface.

controls.title: Password hashing uses approved functions only
controls.objective: Verify passwords use argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and that MD5 and SHA-1 are not used for security.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(argon2|bcrypt|scrypt|PBKDF2|passlib|hashlib\.pbkdf2) and q=(hashlib\.md5|hashlib\.sha1|\bmd5\(|\bsha1\(); GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> for each match to confirm password-hashing use versus non-security use.
controls.expected: Password hashing uses argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2; no hashlib.md5 or hashlib.sha1 for security purposes.
controls.risk: Weak hashes allow password recovery after database theft and credential reuse.
controls.recommendation: Replace MD5/SHA-1 with argon2, bcrypt, scrypt or PBKDF2 and migrate existing hashes.
controls.quote: Les mots de passe sont hachés avec argon2, bcrypt, scrypt ou PBKDF2. MD5 et SHA-1 sont interdits pour tout usage de sécurité.

requirements.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.
requirements.summary: Requires CI to run static security analysis with bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on each change.
requirements.why: Testable by inspecting CI workflow files for static analysis steps via tree and file interface.

controls.title: CI runs static security analysis on each change
controls.objective: Verify CI executes bandit, semgrep or CodeQL on every modification.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list .github/workflows files; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<workflow> to verify a step invoking bandit, semgrep or CodeQL with on: [push, pull_request] or equivalent; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(bandit|semgrep|codeql) to corroborate.
controls.expected: At least one workflow runs bandit or semgrep or CodeQL on push and pull_request.
controls.risk: Missing static analysis lets injectable code and hardcoded secrets reach production.
controls.recommendation: Add bandit, semgrep or CodeQL to the CI pipeline on every push and pull request.
controls.quote: La chaîne d'intégration continue exécute une analyse statique de sécurité (bandit, semgrep ou CodeQL) à chaque modification.

requirements.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).
requirements.summary: Requires dependencies pinned to exact versions and audited in CI.
requirements.why: Testable by inspecting requirements files for exact pins and CI files for audit tool via tree, file and search.

controls.title: Dependencies pinned and audited in CI
controls.objective: Verify dependencies are pinned to exact versions and audited in continuous integration.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=requirements.txt to verify every entry uses == with exact version; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list workflows then GET file for each to verify pip-audit or equivalent step; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(pip-audit|safety|dependabot) to corroborate.
controls.expected: All requirements use paquet==version with no unbounded specifiers; CI contains pip-audit or equivalent audit step.
controls.risk: Unpinned and unaudited dependencies allow introduction of known vulnerable packages.
controls.recommendation: Pin all dependencies to exact versions and add pip-audit or equivalent to CI.
controls.quote: Les dépendances sont épinglées à une version exacte (`paquet==version`) et auditées en intégration continue (pip-audit ou équivalent).

requirements.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.
requirements.summary: Requires test data to be synthetic declared with synthetic true and no versioned production export.
requirements.why: Testable by searching fixtures and tests for synthetic markers and production-export indicators via search and file.

controls.title: Test data is synthetic and no production export is versioned
controls.objective: Verify test data is declared synthetic and that no production export is stored in the repository.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/tree to list tests and fixtures; GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q="synthetic"\s*:\s*true and q=(production|prod_dump|real_iban|export.*prod); GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<fixture> to verify synthetic true declaration and absence of real production data.
controls.expected: Fixtures contain "synthetic": true; no versioned file contains production exports or real customer data.
controls.risk: Versioned production data exposes customer data and violates data minimisation in non-production.
controls.recommendation: Replace fixtures with synthetic data marked "synthetic": true and remove any production exports from version control.
controls.quote: Les données de test sont synthétiques et déclarées comme telles (champ `"synthetic": true`) ; aucun export de production n'est versionné.

requirements.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
requirements.summary: Requires the application to log authentication successes and failures.
requirements.why: Testable by searching application code for authentication logging statements via the read-only search interface.

controls.title: Authentication successes and failures are logged
controls.objective: Verify the application logs both successful and failed authentication events.
controls.test_procedure: GET /api/repo/paiement-api/search?q=(login|authenticate|auth).*log and q=logger\.(info|warning|error) and q=(authentication.*(success|fail)|login.*(success|fail)); GET /api/repo/paiement-api/file?path=<file> for each match to confirm both success and failure paths are logged.
controls.expected: Code contains logging for both authentication success and authentication failure events.
controls.risk: Missing auth logs prevent detection of brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks.
controls.recommendation: Add logging of authentication successes and failures with appropriate detail without logging secrets.
controls.quote: Les réussites et les échecs d'authentification sont journalisés par l'application.
